summary: Every checkable claim in the report matches the checks, snapshot, rendered HTML and screenshots. The only flaws the grader found (title shown twice on post pages, a thin second post, no listing images) are minor presentation issues, not breakage the report hid.

claims.claim: Element types heroBlock (heading, subheading, background image), richTextBlock, imageBlock (image + caption) in Blocks/
claims.evidence: snapshot.json lists all three in folder 'Blocks' with exactly those properties; check.json schema.elementVsDocumentFolders passes

claims.claim: Data type 'Blog Blocks' (Umbraco.BlockGrid) referencing the three blocks; reused shipped data types
claims.evidence: snapshot.json: 'Blog Blocks' in Custom/Umbraco.BlockGrid; the properties use TextBox, RichText, MediaPicker3 and DateTime editors

claims.claim: blogFrontPage and blogPost (summary, publishDate, block grid) in Pages/, templates attached, siteRoot allows blogFrontPage
claims.evidence: snapshot.json shows both types in 'Pages' with those properties; check.json schema.blockGridOnPages passes; grade.md confirms templates are assigned and siteRoot allows blogFrontPage

claims.claim: Media folder Blog with 5 Unsplash photos, credits in captions
claims.evidence: check.json content.hasMedia 5 and mediaFromProvidedPhotos 5/5; the figcaptions in both post HTML files read 'Photo by ... on Unsplash'

claims.claim: Front page 'The MCP Blog' with domain /, two published posts, each hero → rich text → image → rich text
claims.evidence: check.json content.domainAssigned, content.allPublished and content.twoBlogPosts pass; in the post HTML the hero section is followed by rich text, a figure and rich text

claims.claim: Adapter-only partials mapping to plain models, ViewComponents Hero/RichText/Image, GetBlockGridHtmlAsync
claims.evidence: check.json code.adapterPerBlock, adaptersHaveNoMarkup, adaptersInvokeViewComponents, viewComponentPerBlock and pagesUseBlockGridHelper all pass

claims.claim: .richtext typography added to site.css; frontend rebuilt
claims.evidence: check.json changes list Umbraco.Bench.Frontend/src/site.css as modified; code.frontendBuilt passes; blogpost screenshot shows styled prose

claims.claim: All three pages HTTP 200; zero 'Could not render component' fallbacks
claims.evidence: check.json crawl: 3 pages, status 200, renderErrors empty

claims.claim: Captioned images with signed crop URLs; media and dist/site.css serve 200
claims.evidence: check.json crawl assets: img URLs carry hmac and return 200; site.css 200; site.noUnsignedResizeUrls passes

claims.claim: Post links present on front page
claims.evidence: check.json site.frontPageLinksPosts 2/2; frontpage screenshot shows both post cards

claims.claim: Built entirely through MCP, no migration plans
claims.evidence: check.json process.intendedChannel 'built through mcp' and code.noMigrationsWritten pass

claims.claim: Nothing broken; MCP-server quirks (layout array format, create-document drops block properties, create-template rejects ?/&)
claims.evidence: these are process observations about tool behaviour; they are consistent with the final state but were not checked against the transcript. No breakage appears in check.json (43/43) or grade.md

claims.claim: How to view: https://localhost:44317/ plus post URLs, backoffice /umbraco
claims.evidence: the post paths match the check.json crawl paths exactly
